parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of the migration autodetector crashing when renaming a model and field simultaneously. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces a note in the code about the potential issues of renaming a model and a field simultaneously, which is a stylistic addition rather than a functional change.
